text: Risk management is the process of dealing with possible problems before they happen. First, you need to identify risks, which means finding things that could go wrong. For example, a company might worry about losing important data. After that, you create mitigation strategies to reduce the chance or impact of these risks, such as making regular backups. It is also wise to prepare contingency plans, so you know what to do if a risk actually occurs. Finally, you must keep monitoring the situation, because new risks can appear at any time and old ones may change.
